clientReview: User accepted the original weapon appearances and repaired wave fixture. Long-blade F1 routing and expanded Colt test-motion selection have native/package validation; no new client acceptance is claimed. Production motion overlays are excluded. Vibro Blades — Sword (F2/row 1, appearance 121) and Ares Predator IV (F7/row 61, colour 5, bottom 065) were reviewed in the NWN:EE client on both shipped Human bodies from their private itemkit fixtures (screenshots and logs retained locally); the user approved both visually. This is not production animation, ammunition or exhaustive equipment acceptance. Ceramic Knife (F1/row 22, 111), Extendable Baton (F2/row 1, 171), Tomahawk (F2, 181), Baseball Bat (F4/row 13, 091) and Stun Staff (F5/row 50, 081) were reviewed in the NWN:EE client on both shipped Human bodies from their private itemkit fixtures (scripted captures retained locally); the user approved each visually. This is not production acceptance. Melee wave 1: Survival Knife (F1/row 22, 091), Sword (F2/row 1, 131), Club (F2, 141) and Claymore (F4/row 13, 081) were viewed in the NWN:EE client from their private itemkit fixtures; the user kept each ("Yes, keep it"; for the Sword this was its 1.10 m size). Not production acceptance. The Claymore and Club grip-depth departures were hand-fit reviewed on both Human bodies from scripted idle captures of rebuilds of the same fits (Claymore run-fixture-v5 refixture-2 captures-2, Club run-fixture-v2 captures-1); user: "Hand fit is fine".
blueprintPublicationPolicy: Approved wave blueprints unchanged. Cougar long blade: BaseItem 0->22 and three part bytes 71->81 only; equal-length model aliases preserve all corner attributes. Legacy model/icon resources remain. New F1 icons fit the existing silhouette into32x32. The Vibro sword and Ares Predator IV blueprints and resources are byte-identical to their accepted itemkit packages; F2 MaxRange 111->121 and Sling MaxRange 52->65 only extend the appearance picker. The five wave-2 melee blueprints and resources are byte-identical to their reviewed itemkit packages; F1 MaxRange 100->111 and F2 MaxRange 121->181 only extend the appearance picker. The four wave-1 melee blueprints and resources are byte-identical to the native packages and fixture modules of the runs the user approved; no table change.
